original_value: The increasingly severe network security situation brings unanticipated challenges to mobile networking. Traditional HMM (Hidden Markov Model) based algorithms for predicting the network security are not accurate, and to address this issue, a weighted HMM based algorithm is proposed to predict the security situation of the mobile network. The multiscale entropy is used to address the low speed of data training in mobile network, whereas the parameters of HMM situation transition matrix are also optimized. Moreover, the autocorrelation coefficient can reasonably use the association between the characteristics of the historical data to predict future security situation. Experimental analysis on DARPA2000 shows that the proposed algorithm is highly competitive, with good performance in prediction speed and accuracy when compared to existing design.

result.paraphrase: The increasingly severe network security situation poses unexpected challenges for mobile networking. Traditional HMM (Hidden Markov Model) based network security prediction algorithms are not accurate, so a weighted HMM-based algorithm is proposed to forecast the security situation of the mobile network. Multiscale entropy is used to address the slow speed of data training in mobile networks, and the parameters of the HMM situation transition matrix are also optimized. In addition, the autocorrelation coefficient can effectively leverage relationships among historical data features to predict future security situations. Experimental analysis on DARPA2000 shows that the proposed algorithm is highly competitive and performs well in both prediction speed and accuracy compared with existing designs.
